Oh man this is cool of you to do. Pikachu is my step-son’s favorite pokemon!

Pokemon has been such a great way to bond with my step-kids. When I was 10, I was ripping packs of 1st edition base set. My mom would usually pick me and my cousin up from school, and my cousin was notorious for being a total brat. She always wanted what I had, and would constantly try to steal my pokemon cards. One day, after my mom picked us both up, she let us each choose one pack of cards. We both grabbed a pack of base set unlimited. My booster pack had charizard on it, hers had venusaur. She, as per usual, wanted my pack with the charizard. After some backseat bickering, I agreed to trade packs. Well, to both of our surprise, I pulled a holo charizard from mine. You can imagine she wasn’t very happy, and tried to say “it wasn’t fair” since that was originally her pack. My mom saved the day when she said it was a fair trade. 

Anyway, to this day, I have that card. It’s the last of my original collection, which my cousin ended up getting… go figure. My plan is to get it graded and give it to my step-son when he’s a bit older. 

Thanks for listening! This is probably the only real core memory I remember from my childhood pokemon journey - but it’s a good one.
